title: Technology
description: A strictly-beneficial unlock node in one of the three research trees. Adopting a tech never imposes a penalty; the only cost is the opportunity cost of research spent elsewhere.

tree.description: theory = macro frameworks; applied = deployable tools/ops; infrastructure = data/computing that lifts the fog and speeds the other trees.

external.description: true = arrives from academia/peer central banks once developed in the world; false = the player can pioneer it.

earliest.description: Earliest in-game year-month the node can become available.

absorb_modifier_var.description: State var whose value scales absorption speed for external techs.

unlocks.description: What becomes available. All entries are gains.

divisions.description: Org-chart divisions this tech brings into existence, e.g. the IT division.
